name: Embedded and Autonomous Systems (M.Sc.)
university: West Saxon University of Applied Sciences Zwickau (Westsächsische Hochschule Zwickau)
tuitionText: No tuition fees / semester fee only (programme page).

deadlines.text: Admission-restricted programmes, winter semester: 30 April for non-EU nationals (also 30 April for EU nationals). Programme is listed as 'restricted entry'.

deadlineNote: Applicants with foreign qualifications must apply via uni-assist (max. two programmes). Programme starts in winter semester only. Programme page also requires proof of German at A1 level.
englishRequirement: English level B2 (no specific test score given)
admissionRequirements: Completed bachelor's degree in electrical engineering with at least 180 ECTS, English B2, German A1 and a self-assessment of subject-specific competencies; admission is restricted.
description: A four-semester English-taught master's covering embedded software, digital signal processing, distributed systems, electric drives, vehicle dynamics and algorithms for autonomous systems, finishing with a master thesis. Graduates target R&D and project roles in automotive, aerospace and robotics.

name: Management and Information Technology (M.Sc., Double Degree)
university: West Saxon University of Applied Sciences Zwickau (Westsächsische Hochschule Zwickau)
tuitionText: 500 EUR per semester plus semester fee; no tuition fees for EU citizens and students of a partner university. Five scholarships are awarded to students subject to tuition fees.

deadlines.text: Admission-restricted programmes, winter semester: 30 April for non-EU nationals (programme is 'restricted entry').

deadlineNote: Applicants with foreign qualifications apply via uni-assist. Double degree: students study at WHZ and at one partner university in Kazakhstan, Armenia, Georgia or Kyrgyzstan. An admission interview may be required.
admissionRequirements: First university degree (at least 180 ECTS) in management, business administration, international relations, language science, computer science or a related field, plus English B2 and German A2; an admission interview may be required.
description: An interdisciplinary double-degree master's combining management, business information systems and computer science, taught at WHZ and one of four partner universities in Central Asia/Caucasus. It trains graduates for roles such as IT/project manager, software engineer or data analyst.

name: Data Science in Business and Economics (M.Sc.)

deadlineNote: Admission restricted; shortlisted candidates are interviewed by video conference.
englishRequirement: Fluency in English required; no test score stated

admissionRequirements: Bachelor's degree in business studies or economics (or comparable) with excellent grades, solid statistics/mathematics/econometrics background and experience coding in R or Python.
description: A research-oriented master's combining econometrics, data science methods and business/economics applications. Excluded here because it is taught in German and English and requires German proficiency.

name: Innovation Management, Entrepreneurship, and Sustainability (M.Sc.)
tuitionText: Not stated on the fetched pages.

deadlines.text: Restricted admission, English-taught master's: 01.04.2027 until 15.05.2027 (winter semester 2027/28). Applications with international credentials have the same deadlines.

deadlineNote: Restricted admission (ranking list up to 100 points). Applicants with a foreign first degree must also submit a VPD (preliminary review documentation) from uni-assist; application itself goes to TU Berlin. Double-degree options with Twente, SGH Warsaw or NTNU.
admissionRequirements: First university degree in economics, social sciences, engineering, natural sciences or a related field; ranking based on grade and credits in economics, methodology, sustainability, mathematics and statistics.

name: International Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Double Degree
university: Hochschule Bremen - City University of Applied Sciences (International Graduate Center)
tuitionText: Fee-paying programme: from 17,000 EUR in total depending on the partner university, plus approx. 420 EUR semester fees per semester (applies to all students).

deadlines.text: Application period 1 October to 31 March for the winter semester

deadlineNote: Run by HSB's International Graduate Center; two degrees from two countries (IBSA alliance). Application process not described on the page.
admissionRequirements: Business-related bachelor's degree (210 ECTS) and at least two years of work experience.
description: A one-year-plus, fee-based international MBA where students study in two countries and receive two master's degrees from International Business School Alliance partners, with specialisations such as logistics or marketing.

name: Advanced Semiconductor Nanotechnologies (M.Sc.)
tuitionText: Not listed on the programme page.

deadlines.text: Applicants with an international Bachelor's degree apply via uni-assist: 15 July

deadlineNote: Restricted admission; a motivation letter in English (max. 1,000 words) is required. Applicants with a German bachelor's apply directly to OVGU by the same date.
englishRequirement: English at B2 level (no specific test score on the page)
admissionRequirements: B.Sc., diploma or comparable degree in electrical engineering, physics or a closely related programme, plus English B2 and a motivation letter.
description: A research-oriented English-taught master's on semiconductor device physics, nanofabrication and microtechnology, created alongside the semiconductor industry build-up in Magdeburg.

name: Electrical Engineering, Information Technology and Computer Engineering (M.Sc.)
deadlineNote: RWTH lists this programme under 'expiring study programmes'; first-semester entry is no longer possible. It has been split into two separate master's programmes: Electrical Engineering and Information Technology M.Sc. and Computer Engineering M.Sc.
description: Former English-taught RWTH master's with six majors; replaced by the Electrical Engineering and Information Technology M.Sc. and the Computer Engineering M.Sc.

description: HTW Berlin's master's in information and communication technology is taught in German, so it is excluded.

name: Mechatronics and Robotics (M.Eng.)
university: Schmalkalden University of Applied Sciences (Hochschule Schmalkalden)
tuitionText: Not mentioned on the programme page.

deadlines.text: Application period: 1st of February - 15th of April

name: Quantum Engineering (M.Sc.)

Summer semester: application window mid-December to 1 March

admissionRequirements: Bachelor's degree (German or equivalent foreign) with a focus on quantum engineering or a related subject, grade 2.5 or better, with minimum credits in physics fundamentals (e.g. 36 CP).

languageNote: English (lectures and examinations entirely in English)

deadlineNote: Admission restricted (Uni-NC), 30 places per year, winter intake only. The university states that deadlines for all 2027 master's programmes are being revised; check again in late February. The studienangebot.uni-halle.de programme page could not be fetched directly.
